title: Do not wash in dishwasher!
text:
Do not wash in dishwasher!. Have not used it. Arrived to late for the batch of ravs we had to make 7 dozen by hand. Will try it next time.
I had 1 years back like this it belonged to my grandmother, then mother.
Sadly my hubby put it through a dishwasher and that then caused the metal tray to bleed gray color marks on my dough.

This one will never. See water!

product_metadata.title: Fantes Ravioli Maker, Makes 1 Dozen Raviolis, The Italian Market Original since 1906
features: Fantes Grandpa Dante's Ravioli Maker easily forms, fills, seals, and cuts authentic 2-inch homemade ravioli with fluted edges, 1 dozen at a time
Made from aluminum and plastic with non-skid rubber feet; BPA free; compact for easy storage; measures 12 x 4.5 x 0.75-inches
Quickly make 1-dozen 2-inch square ravioli with classic fluted edges; uniform-sized pasta cooks evenly for better-tasting results
Roll out pasta dough and drape over the base, form wells and spoon in ravioli filling, drape a second sheet of dough, seal and cut with a rolling pin
Non-skid rubber feet keep it in place during use; includes instructions and Fante’s family recipes; hand wash in warm, soapy water
description: Fantes Grandpa Dante's Ravioli Maker easily creates authentic stuffed pasta. It forms, fills, seals, and cuts 1-dozen 2-inch square ravioli at a time. Nothing tastes better than homemade pasta and uniformly sized ravioli cooks evenly for better-tasting results. Simply roll and cut a sheet of dough and drape over the Ravioli Maker base. Firmly press the rounded form into the dough to create wells, remove the form and spoon in the ravioli filling. Drape another sheet of dough on top and press a rolling pin across the top to cut the pasta and seal in the stuffing. Cook according to recipe. It features classic fluted edges to make authentic looking pasta. Its non-skid rubber feet keep it from sliding away during use. Includes instructions and Fante’s family recipes. Made from aluminum and plastic with non-skid rubber feet, Fante’s Grandpa Dante's Ravioli Maker is sturdy, durable, compact for easy storage, and BPA free. Hand wash in warm, soapy water. Fante’s, The Italian Market Original since 1906. Brought to you by HIC, a third-generation family owned and operated company in the USA since 1957.
